actions.action: Pull the Mother of Thousands plantlets by the base with roots
Check soil surface weekly for new Mother of Thousands babies
Pull the tiny round-leaved seedlings or pot them up separately
Snip off seed heads once flowers fade
Repot when roots poke out of drainage hole or water runs straight through

reason: The answer calls the plant healthy and says the fast-draining cactus mix suits it, which misses the nutrient depletion caused by that soil and discourages the repot into less-draining soil that fixed it, so it delays the fix despite rightly advising removal of the Kalanchoe.
